fields.label: URL

fields.description: The number of seconds to wait for a response before the request fails
fields.label: Timeout (Seconds)

fields.description: HTTP headers to send with the request, as a JSON object
fields.label: Headers (JSON)

fields.description: When disabled, process_inventory_transaction rejects every request with a maintenance message.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Maximum number of transactions accepted in a single process_inventory_transaction request.
fields.label: Max Batch Size

fields.description: When enabled, accepted transactions create their Stock Entry / Purchase Receipt and submit it immediately on submit of the transaction (for Stock Entry this also sets 'Viewed By Warehouse' to bypass the manual warehouse-manager approval step). When disabled, the target document is created in Draft for manual review and submission.
fields.label: Auto Submit Created Documents
Item API
fields.description: process_item. Create = missing master data is created automatically; Stop = the Item is rejected and the missing value is reported.

fields.label: Missing Item Group
fields.description: Create uses Default Parent Item Group below.

fields.label: Missing Barcode
fields.description: Stop = barcode is required in the payload. Create = an Item without a barcode is accepted. A barcode already used by another Item is always rejected.

fields.label: Missing Supplier
fields.description: Create = a minimal Supplier is created from supplier (code) and supplier_name only, skipping the Supplier's other mandatory fields. Stop = the Item is rejected.

fields.label: Missing Local Zone Tax Template
fields.description: Create uses Tax Template Company / Account below.

fields.label: Missing Free Zone Tax Template
fields.description: Create uses Tax Template Company / Account below.

fields.label: Tax Template Account
fields.description: Tax account used on Item Tax Templates created by the Item API.

fields.label: Tax Rate Mapping
fields.description: Used when more than one Item Tax Template has the received rate (e.g. 0% zero-rated vs exempt). An ambiguous rate with no mapping is rejected.

fields.label: Supplier API
fields.description: process_supplier. Create = missing master data is created automatically; Stop = the Supplier is rejected and the missing value is reported.

fields.label: Missing Supplier Group
fields.description: Create uses Default Parent Supplier Group below.

fields.label: Missing Territory
fields.description: Create uses Default Parent Territory below.

fields.label: Missing National ID
fields.description: National ID is mandatory on Supplier, so a missing value is rejected either way - it is never generated.

fields.label: Missing Tax ID
fields.description: Tax ID is mandatory on Supplier, so a missing value is rejected either way - it is never generated.

fields.label: Primary Address
fields.description: Create = the primary Address is created from supplier_primary_address. Stop = the Supplier is rejected if no address is sent.

fields.label: Primary Contact
fields.description: Create = the primary Contact is created from supplier_primary_contact. Stop = the Supplier is rejected if no contact is sent.

fields.label: Default Territory Number of Days
fields.description: Territory Details.number_of_days when the payload does not send territory_days.

fields.label: Supplier Agreement API
fields.description: process_supplier_agreement. Creates Draft Supplier Agreements (Blanket Orders). Items and Suppliers are never created by this API.

fields.label: Missing Supplier Agreement Type
fields.description: Create = the Supplier Agreement Type is created. Stop = the agreement is rejected.

fields.label: Other Terms
fields.description: Create = a missing Terms and Conditions record is created from the received title and text; agreements without Other Terms are accepted. Stop = missing Other Terms or a missing Terms and Conditions record rejects the agreement.

fields.label: Received Penalties
fields.description: The API never creates penalties. Ignore = received penalties are discarded (kept only in the raw payload). Stop = an agreement that contains penalties is rejected.

fields.label: Missing Items
fields.description: Items are never created by this API. Stop = any missing Item rejects the agreement (all missing Items are listed). Ignore = rows with a missing Item are left out; an agreement with no remaining rows is rejected.

fields.label: Pricing Difference
fields.options:
Stop
Warn in Terms and Conditions
Ignore
fields.description: When received prices differ from the system calculation (masar_mce_api.pricing). Stop = rejected. Warn = created with the system values and a warning appended to General Terms and Conditions. Ignore = created with the system values.

fields.label: Default Agreement Company
fields.description: Used when the payload has no company. Falls back to the global default company.
